title: Utah 'Karen' Loses Her Mind Over Teen's Skirt
description:
A Utah woman who went viral for allegedly yanking down a woman’s skirt in a restaurant in St. George, Utah had a lot more to say after the incident. Bodycam video released after the video went viral on TikTok shows the woman, Ida Lorenzo, 49, at the police station to complain about the backlash she was receiving for her newfound fame. Police also spoke to witnesses who had a much different story. In the end, it was Ida now dubbed a "Karen" in the viral clip who ended up in handcuffs. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
